experiment: CC-SAM Stage II feature-gradient transfer on the sealed Clean Stage I

dataset.name: CIFAR-100-LT
dataset.class_counts_source: sealed Clean Stage I TRAIN split
dataset.validation: 1980 images held out from official TRAIN; 20 images for class IDs 1..99; class 0 absent
dataset.official_test: prohibited; no test images or labels may be opened, decoded, evaluated, or used for selection

clean_stage1.classifier_initialization: same Clean Stage I classifier checkpoint for every arm and every Stage-II seed

source_method.paper: Class-Conditional Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Deep Long-Tailed Recognition
source_method.transfer_scope: Stage II feature-gradient perturbation only; not a full reproduction of the original two-stage CC-SAM pipeline
source_method.representation: 64-dimensional GAP embedding after the Clean ResNet-32 feature map [B,64,8,8]; this matches the pooled feature vector used by the official CC-SAM ResNet32 implementation

stage2.learning_rate_schedule: constant 0.01 for CIFAR Stage II, matching the official CC-SAM adjust_learning_rate implementation for the 30-epoch Stage-II window
stage2.backbone: frozen; eval mode; all parameters and BN buffers checked bitwise unchanged
stage2.sampler: class-aware sampler; a single per-seed 30-epoch sampling plan is shared across all three arms

ccsam_stage2_hyperparameters.feature_perturbation: delta_i = adver_reg * w_yi * g_yi / ||g_yi||_2; g_c is the gradient of the mean clean CE over samples of class c with respect to the pooled 64-D feature batch

arms.description: Frozen-backbone class-aware balanced CE; cRT-style matched control. Retains the Clean Stage I classifier as the common initialization, so it is not claimed to be a strict canonical cRT reinitialization.
CC-SAM Stage II-inspired feature-gradient perturbation, with official class weights and alpha schedule.
Same class-aware sampler, class weights, alpha schedule, optimizer, and initialization as C1, but delta is exactly zero; isolates the incremental contribution of feature perturbation.

primary_comparisons.C1-C2: added contribution of class-conditional feature-gradient perturbation
primary_comparisons.C2-C0: contribution of class weighting and alpha blend without feature perturbation

analysis.caveat: Three Stage-II seeds share one Clean Stage-I backbone and one reused development validation partition; they do not establish independent-backbone or cross-dataset generalization.
